gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic reads with its weight packed into the middle of the line, and its s and c stay uncrowded. Offside sits above it, widely tracked and expressive, with curves that never quite close.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Noto Sans Cuneiform has lowercase letters puffed up like glass beads. Offside's neon-tube lines hum above them, so paragraphs below feel rounded, open and easy to settle into.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Offside draws stencil-cut letters of one steady width, spaced wide and held in a level, commanding beat. Noto Sans Deseret does the quieter job, with open apertures and a high, wide lowercase that stays easy on the eye.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Offside brings a unit-width stroke and wide tracking, with curves that refuse to close and a commanding voice. But Noto Sans Devanagari is the one that handles running text, its compact skyline blending capitals into lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Offside sets its widely tracked, unvarying line down with expressive authority, never letting a curve quite shut. Noto Sans Duployan follows, its oversized counters making a long page easy going.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: A stroke where every curve is as thick as a straight stem gives Offside its commanding look; a larger heading size lets that wide tracking breathe. Noto Sans Elbasan fills in beneath with large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Offside holds a pen line at one width, spaced wide, with curves that stay open and a commanding air. Noto Sans Elymaic handles the everyday work, its open apertures and low ascenders keeping text tidy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Expressive and strange, like a bent paperclip. Offside spreads its looping heading out wide, while Noto Sans Ethiopic stands underneath with a tall, sturdy lowercase and c terminals hanging far from the bowl.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Wide, steady and technical-pen precise. Offside's curves refuse to close, and Noto Sans Georgian settles in below with open apertures and short ascender stems, which is why the pairing feels so composed.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-sans-glagolitic: Commanding, wide and unhurried. Offside gives every part of a letter the same visual mass for display, and Noto Sans Glagolitic does the opposite job, with open round letters that stay clear at small sizes.
